image_description: A dark, metallic chain with twisted or figure-eight shaped links drapes in a catenary curve across the frame. The left end is attached to a vertical gray textured surface (resembling a ladder or grate), and the right end connects to a large, glossy, toroidal ring with a greenish-black marble or metallic pattern. The background is stark white.
